note: Van Buren County Conservation campground on the south shore of 579-acre Lake Sugema, between Keosauqua and Cantril off Highway 2. A row of full-hookup sites, a modern loop on a wooded point, and a gravel drive-in row; accessible shower house, dump station, boat dock and trailer parking with electric. Hiking trail to Lacey-Keosauqua State Park from the east end. Camp hosts 319-293-3532. --Claude
summary: Fees 22-27 -> 15-27 (gravel drive-in $15); 50 amp, 28 sites, season year-round (water off Nov-Mar), 5-day booking lead and holiday minimum added. Waterfront lead down: lakeview -> not waterfront (no on-water candidates). Pin in the lake.
